title: Daniel in the Lions' Den
lines: This is Daniel, who was a Jewish man who was taken to Babylon when he was very young.
這是但以理，他是個猶太人，年紀很小就被擄到巴比倫。
Daniel loved God and followed God's rules.
但以理愛神，遵守神的律例。
He talked to God three times a day and asked God for help often.
他一天三次向神禱告，常常求神幫助。
Daniel served in the Babylonian king's court for many years, and under many kings.
但以理在巴比倫王的朝廷中事奉多年，歷經好幾位君王。
Daniel always proved himself to be more capable than all the other court officials.
但以理總是證明自己比朝中所有官員都更有才幹。
Daniel was serving under King Darius, and because of his great abilities, the king made plans to place him in charge of the entire empire.
但以理在大利烏王手下任職，因他才能出眾，王打算立他治理全國。
The other court officials searched for some fault in Daniel, but they couldn't find anything wrong with him.
其他官員想找但以理的把柄，卻找不到他有任何錯處。
He was faithful, responsible, and completely trustworthy.
他忠心、盡責，完全值得信賴。
The court officials realized the only way to get at Daniel would be to challenge his faith.
官員們意識到，要對付但以理，唯一的辦法就是從他的信仰下手。
So they went to King Darius and advised him to make a law that for the next thirty days, any person who prays to anyone except King Darius will be thrown into the lions' den.
於是他們去見大利烏王，建議他立一條法令：三十天內，凡向大利烏王以外的任何對象祈求的，必被扔進獅子坑。
King Darius signed this law, and once a Babylonian king signed a law, it could not be overruled.
大利烏王簽署了這條法令；巴比倫王一旦簽了法令，就不能更改。
When Daniel learned of this law, he went home and knelt down as he always did to pray in his room, with the windows open towards Jerusalem.
但以理知道了這條法令，就回到家裡，照常在房間裡跪下禱告，窗戶開向耶路撒冷。
He prayed three times a day, just as he always had done, giving thanks to God and asking for his help.
他一日三次禱告，跟往常一樣，感謝神，也求神幫助。
The officials went to Daniel's house and found him praying.
官員們到但以理家，發現他正在禱告。
They went to the king and reminded him of the law.
他們去見王，提醒他那條法令。
Then they said that Daniel had been found praying to God three times a day.
接著他們說，但以理被人看見一天三次向神禱告。
When the king heard this, he was very upset.
And he spent the whole day trying to think of a way to save Daniel.
他花了一整天想辦法要救但以理。
By that evening, the court officials came back to the king and reminded him that no law signed by the Babylonian king could be overruled.
到了傍晚，官員們又來見王，提醒他巴比倫王所簽的法令都不能更改。
So at last the king gave orders for Daniel to be thrown into the lions' den.
王終於下令，把但以理扔進獅子坑。
The king said to him, "May your God, whom you serve faithfully, rescue you."
王對他說：「你所常事奉的神，必救你！」
Then the lions' den was sealed shut with Daniel inside.
然後獅子坑被封住，但以理在裡面。
The king spent the night fasting and couldn't sleep.
Then very early in the morning, the king hurried to the lions' den.
次日清早，王急忙往獅子坑去。
He called out, "Daniel, was your God able to rescue you from the lions?"
他喊道：「但以理啊，你的神能救你脫離獅子嗎？」
And Daniel answered, "Long live the king!"
"My God sent his angel to shut the lions' mouths so that they would not hurt me, for I have been found innocent in his sight."
「我的神差遣使者封住獅子的口，叫獅子不傷我，因我在神面前無辜。」
The king was overjoyed and ordered that Daniel be taken out of the lions' den.
王非常歡喜，吩咐人把但以理從坑裡拉上來。
Then the king ordered the men who had schemed against Daniel to be thrown into the lions' den as punishment.
王又下令，把那些設計陷害但以理的人扔進獅子坑作為懲罰。
Daniel was safe. There was not a scratch on him, for he trusted in God.
但以理平安無事，身上毫無傷損，因為他信靠神。
